final_test_status: No promotion or final evaluation: two new final games are required and are not available. WR9 remains unopened; inspect prior-use records before using it in a later frozen final protocol.
basis: Development-only diagnosis finds extra adaptive false phases with high local winner agreement as well as real added phases. Thus a strong score alone does not establish physical control. Missed short phases often have nearby opponents. Add an observable ball-action cue, not another relaxation of transition costs.
hypothesis: A plausible change in ball velocity in immediate player proximity can strengthen an otherwise weak controlled reception/pass signal. A deflection can generate the same observations, so this cue remains bounded and is not declared proof of control.
change: Contact-only addition to controlled geometry: estimate before/after ball velocity over 0.12 s each, using complete original observations only. Reject windows containing steps over 45 m/s. Strength=clip((norm(v_after-v_before)-3)/7,0,1). Contact weight=strength*exp(-(minimum_distance/1.2)^2), zero in existing dead-like regions. Blend instantaneous evidence towards 2.5*clip((max(dA-0.6,0)-max(dH-0.6,0))/0.6,-1,1) with this weight; use max(original close weight,contact weight) for existing persistence/memory. All other constants, tags, D emissions, duration and static costs remain controlled defaults. No adaptive discounts, reliability filter, identity assumption or new training.
parameter_basis: One physical engineering hypothesis; 0.12 s local velocity windows, 3..10 m/s change range, 1.2 m proximity and existing 0.6 m touch allowance. Values fixed before candidate evaluation, not selected by score sweeps.
timing: One clean warm-up per profile and three alternating predict-only repetitions; exclude loading, copies and diagnostics. Verify deterministic prediction hashes.
stopping_rule: One candidate evaluation on development after synthetic tests. If any gate fails, reject and retain controlled; no within-experiment retuning. Otherwise keep experimental pending two new final games, without scoring competition labels or consumed final games.
stress_test: Fixed seed 505: independently start a 10-frame missing-ball burst with probability 0.002 per source frame; add independent 0.10 m Gaussian XY noise on remaining observations. Missing distances become NaN; retained distances remain unperturbed, so this is a feature-channel consistency stress test, not a physically regenerated tracking scene. Apply identical corruption to both profiles. Report separately; never select based on reference-dependent masks.
limitations: Development games are reused and have cleaner provider observations. Sparse events or automatic possession estimates from new sources are not dense independent gold labels. No claim of transfer, significance or perfect recovery.
